# Pattu Pavadas

> Pattu Pavadas is an Indian manufacturer and supplier of traditional girls’ pattu pavada, pattu pavadai, pattu langa and langa blouse sets. Retail, wholesale and bulk orders are available, with delivery across India and export enquiries welcome.

Ethnic Collections makes South Indian festive wear for families, boutiques, wholesalers and exporters. Product availability, sizes, minimum order quantities, delivery timelines and export arrangements should be confirmed with the business before ordering.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.pattupavadas.com/): Manufacturer overview and product information
- [Girls’ collection](https://www.pattupavadas.com/b2c): Retail styles and ordering information
- [Wholesale supply](https://www.pattupavadas.com/b2b): Wholesale, bulk and boutique enquiries
- [Full collection](https://www.pattupavadas.com/collection): Pattu pavada and pattu langa styles
- [Manufacturing](https://www.pattupavadas.com/manufacturing): How the garments are made
- [Contact](https://www.pattupavadas.com/contact): Contact details and retail counter address
- [Pattu Pavada guides](https://www.pattupavadas.com/blog): Sizing, styling, care and buying guides
